title: Quantum Self-Attention Neural Networks for Text Classification
version_notes: Official landing: revision 2023-09-28; PDF title date 2023-09-29. Both retained, not silently equated.

findings.fact: Common encoded input state feeds query, key and value circuits. Value coordinates are Pauli-observable expectations after a unitary; the attention kernel is Gaussian on projected query/key expectations.

findings.locator: p5 Eq8-10; p6 Eq11-18; p7 Algorithm1
findings.fact: Task loss optimizes quantum ansatz and decoder parameters; previous-layer outputs feed later common encoded states. This is not a frozen-teacher value-regression protocol.
The source does not implement the native 1028-to-12 preparer, forty rank-one Born class effects, EPS word normalization and arbitrary bounded class-Hermitian utility as one exact architecture.

interpretation: Same-state bounded quantum values and task optimization have direct precedent. A specific native joint architecture remains untested here; that scope gap does not establish a new structural mechanism, efficacy or theory.
epistemic_limits: No claim that this paper proves all native joint variants equivalent.
No empirical benefit transfers from its text-classification experiments.
No hardware speedup or task-independent impossibility is inferred.
